scope: Complete 0.7.0 App Store and Google Play metadata candidate, complete candidate website copy, and all candidate screenshot captions in docs/marketing/store-web-2026-09-13.

roles.role: Textual accuracy, source anchors, philology, and claims
roles.findings: Verified 24 translation editions in 11 modern languages plus Ancient Greek; 3,288 passage-anchored notes; 230 artworks and objects across 48 museums and collections; and 54 DOI-identified articles represented by 68 citation placements, including 42 with direct full-text URLs. Required bounded wording for counts, rereading behavior, rights, and online article access.

roles.role: Reader usefulness, clarity, art relevance, and provenance
roles.findings: Approved the candidate voice and reader value after correcting museum-only collection wording, publisher-link wording, and the implication that every artwork record has artist and date metadata. Recommended the plainer translation caption as an optional tone improvement.

Resolved both reviews by using museums and collections, DOI links, and collection, source, and rights metadata; added objects to the promotional art count within the platform limit; and adopted the factual 24 translations, to read and compare screenshot caption. All other candidate copy was reviewed and retained without change.

resolved_decision_notes: Use 48 museums and collections because the 48 catalog groups include museums, galleries, a national library, a palace, and named collections.
Use DOI link for the 12 citation-only articles; 42 of the 54 distinct articles have direct full-text URLs online in addition to DOI links.
Describe artwork details as collection, source, and rights because artist and date metadata are not present on every catalog record.
The promotional text names 230 artworks and objects and remains within the 170-byte limit.
Use 24 translations, to read and compare in screenshot captions to keep the claim factual and matter of fact.
Retain the version 0.7.0 preview notice and all unaffected candidate copy as approved. Store copy remains staged for the upcoming release.
retained_candidate_copy: APPROVED: every candidate byte not superseded by the resolved decision notes is retained and approved.
registry_amendment: The final independent reports were reread after their last edits. The 68 figure denotes citation-note placements across 59 distinct anchored line spans, not distinct articles; the resolved public copy correctly states 54 distinct DOI-identified articles and 42 direct full-text links online. No approved artifact bytes changed.
